steps.title: Book equipment over 5,000 EUR as capex with an asset number
steps.decision: Moved the drill press invoice INV-4471 from opex cost center 4711 to capex cost center 0400, added asset number AN-2025-0193, then posted it.
steps.reason: Equipment over five thousand euros is always capex. And no asset number, no capex booking." Equipment means "a machine or a tool we'll use for more than a year"; "Services and consumables stay opex, whatever the amount." If the asset number is missing, "Fixed assets creates it. I send them the invoice and wait. No number, no posting.

steps.title: Send Czech subsidiary invoices for second approval
steps.decision: Set INV-4472 (1,950 EUR, from the Brno subsidiary) to second approval and saved it as pending approval.
steps.reason: It's from our Czech subsidiary. Anything from Brno goes to a second approver, no matter the amount." The second approver is "Our controller. Once you set second approval, the system routes it to him.

steps.title: Hold Brandt December invoices until their statement arrives
steps.decision: Put the Brandt freight invoice INV-4473 on hold with the note "Held: waiting for Brandt's December statement".
steps.reason: Brandt bills December twice almost every year. I hold it until their statement arrives." When the statement arrives, she checks "That the invoice number shows up only once. If it's there twice, I reject the duplicate.
